searchText: Hi guys The Discovery v5.2 protocol version development cycle starts today At this time we are considering the inclusion of several smaller changes: - tweaks to the handshake protocol for improved DoS resistance - support for NAT hole punching I'm still working on larger protocol changes for topic-based discovery, but I think it's better to start with a smaller upgrade. Specifically because there haven't been any protocol version upgrades on discv5 yet Seems easier and safer to test out the upgrade flow with a smaller set of changes If you guys want, we could also explore adding support for ed25519 node identities in this version. But it's not strictly required... Here is the tracking issue for Discovery v5.2: https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/issues/226 <@194432762315407360> what's your appetite like for a protocol-native UTP-like solution for data transfer above the single packet size? I'm working on a proposal for this problem! Lovely I suspect we'd love to part of the discussion so please let us know as soon as you've got anything we can look over.
